design.description: Design system — Apple analysis with tokens, typography, components. Source of truth for all visual decisions.

reference-site.description: Reference site content and assets — read for copy, images, and patterns.

website.description: Target build directory for the Aura website.

builder.description: Builds website pages with full read/write access. Translates specs into HTML/CSS/JS.

designer.description: Design-focused review agent. Reads pages and audits against DESIGN.md. Read-only.

reviewer.description: Quality reviewer — audits for accessibility, anti-patterns, and DESIGN.md compliance. Read-only.

build-page.description: Run ADW pipeline for a single page: Architect → Developer → Reviewer. Usage: /build-page index|manifesto|docs

build-all.description: Run full ADW pipeline for all pages. Usage: /build-all

design-audit.description: Audit the entire site against DESIGN.md. Usage: /design-audit

harness.description: Run the Google Antigravity harness. Usage: /harness --aura "your prompt" or /harness -r "question"
